description: Use when you must refresh or screen many companies by LEI (KYB, vendor or counterparty lists): up to 200 LEIs in one POST, read from GLEIF in one call: legal name, status, addresses. Returns the paid x402 request for your input (POST /company/lei/batch, $0.02 per call; schema linked). POST that JSON body to the URL with an x402 or MPP client to get the data. Bad input is refused before any charge. With an access key (Authorization: Bearer p0k_..., buy at https://x402-bazaar-rank.x402-bazaar-rank-worker.workers.dev/keys/buy?usd=5) the tool pays the call itself, returns the data and deducts the price. First call each day returns the data itself, free; later calls return the paid request.
